caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with a central vertical rod, which is mounted on a three-legged base. The legs are arched and equally spaced, creating a stable tripod structure. At the top of the rod, there is a pincer-like clamp mechanism with a pronounced hinge, and extending from the side is a cylindrical cup attached to a curved arm. The object is rendered in rusty brown and dark gray tones, suggesting aged or oxidized metal. The background is plain and off-white, providing no additional context or objects. In the lower right corner, there is a smaller sketch of the same object, this time with a horizontal rod or stick held in the clamp, with flames on each end of the stick, implying its use as a holder for a burning item. The artist's signature, "H. Langden Brown," appears in the lower left corner.
title: Rush Holder with Candle Socket
